item.title: Dallas named a top city for weddings by WalletHub study
item.description: Dallas ranks 13th in the nation for the best places to get married, according to a new report from WalletHub, which compared 180 cities across 26 key indicators.

item.title: Sabrina Carpenter stars in Pringles ad with crisp companion
item.description: Pringles has released a 30-second Super Bowl commercial featuring pop singer Sabrina Carpenter and a character made entirely of potato crisps, with the slogan "Once You Pop, The Love Don't Stop".

item.title: The most loved and hated NFL players in the Super Bowl: Ranking
item.description: New England Patriots linebacker Christian Elliss and interior defensive lineman Christian Barmore represent the opposite ends of fan sentiment heading into the Super Bowl, according to a recent analysis.

item.title: Ernesta expands with new showrooms in major U.S. cities
item.description: Ernesta is expanding its retail footprint with three new showrooms opening in Michigan, Texas and New York in 2026, offering designer-quality wool and natural fiber rugs to both individual consumers and design professionals.

item.title: Win $15,000 diamond rings at Dave & Buster's Valentine's game
item.description: Dave & Buster's is offering a Valentine's Day promotion that includes five diamond engagement rings in its Human Crane arcade game, as well as a $99 Date Night Duo Deal for couples looking for a unique experience.

item.title: Enter to win Viki Pass and cakes in Valentine's sweepstakes
item.description: Tous les Jours and Rakuten Viki have partnered to offer customers a free one-month trial of Viki Pass Standard with any purchase at participating bakery locations through Feb. 14, as well as a social media sweepstakes with the chance to win an annual Viki Pass Standard subscription and a one-year supply of cakes.

item.title: Culver's unveils new menu and upgrades for 2026
item.description: Culver's has announced a new menu strategy for 2026 that includes four new pub burgers, seasonal desserts, and expanded digital reward features, based on months of research and guest feedback.

item.title: Stage33: K. Avett, "Peace for Me"
item.description: Watch K. Avett perform "Peace for Me" on Stage33.

item.title: Win big with Kinder Bueno's national game day sweepstakes
item.description: Kinder Bueno is launching a "Yes Bueno" campaign with a new spot and a national Game Day Sweepstakes, giving fans a chance to win weekly prizes, including a $25,000 grand prize.

item.title: The Rustic opens new Grandscape venue in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: The Rustic is opening a new location at Grandscape in The Colony this summer, featuring nightly performances by local musicians and wood-grilled American food.
